## Background

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 predictions, 

-HIV-PR_monomer
-HIV-PR_dimer 
-my find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model reliability. 

## 1.HIV-PR Monomer 

Read the 5 AF models. 
```{r}
list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
           full.names=F,
           pattern=".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
           full.names=T,
           pattern=".pdb")

# Print our PDB file names
basename(pdb_files)
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
pdbs
```

###RMSD 

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e pairwise RSMD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
range(rd)
```

and a heatmap display

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

### AF scores(pLDDT)

```{r}
# Read a reference PDB structure
pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2,
       sse=trim.pdb(pdb, chain="A"))
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
```

```{r}
core <- core.find(pdbs)
```

```{r}
core.inds <- print(core, vol=0.5)
```

```{r}
xyz <- pdbfit(pdbs, core.inds, outpath="corefit_structures")
```

###RMSF 

Calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino acid is across all 5 AlphaFold models

```{r}
# Calculate RMSF
rf <- rmsf(xyz)

# Plot RMSF
plotb3(rf, sse=trim.pdb(pdb, chain="A"),
       ylab="RMSF")
```

### AF scores(PAE score plots)

First, read the JSON files: 
```{r}
library(jsonlite)

# List all PAE JSON files
pae_files <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                        pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
                        full.names=TRUE)

basename(pae_files)
```

Then, read the PAE values
```{r}
pae1 <- read_json(pae_files[1], simplifyVector=TRUE)
pae5 <- read_json(pae_files[5], simplifyVector=TRUE)

attributes(pae1)
```

```{r}
# Per-residue pLDDT scores 
#  same as B-factor of PDB..
head(pae1$plddt) 
```

Calculate MAX PAE scores and compare them: 
```{r}
pae1$max_pae
pae5$max_pae
```

Time to plot the PAE heatmaps: 

First for PAE 1
```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

Then, for PAE 5 

```{r}
plot.dmat(pae5$pae,
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

### Residue Conservation

Read the AF MSA 

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

Now, we can check the number of sequences in the alignment: 

```{r}
dim(aln$ali)
```

We can score the residue conservation in the alignment with the conserv() function. 

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

Plot this conservation result: 

```{r}
plotb3(sim[1:99], sse=trim.pdb(pdb, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])

occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:99], m1.pdb$atom$resno)

write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="monomer_conserv.pdb")
```

## 2. HIV-PR Dimer 

Read the 5 AF models. 

```{r}
list.files(path="hiv_dimer_23119_0",
           full.names=F,
           pattern=".pdb")
```


```{r}
dimer_pdb_files <- list.files(
  path="hiv_dimer_23119_0",
  full.names=T,
  pattern=".pdb")

basename(dimer_pdb_files)
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)
dimer_pdbs <- pdbaln(dimer_pdb_files,
                     fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")

dimer_pdbs
```

###RMSD 

Calculate the RMSD of all models 
```{r}
dimer_rd <- rmsd(dimer_pdbs, fit=TRUE)
range(dimer_rd)
```

Heat Map Display: 

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(dimer_rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(dimer_rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)

pheatmap(dimer_rd)
```

### AF scores (pLDDT)

Read the reference PDB structure: 

```{r}
dimer_ref <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```

```{r}
plotb3(dimer_pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2,
       sse=dimer_ref)

points(dimer_pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(dimer_pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(dimer_pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(dimer_pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

abline(v=100, col="gray")
```

```{r}
dimer_core <- core.find(dimer_pdbs)
```

```{r}
dimer_core.inds <- print(dimer_core, vol=0.5)
```

```{r}
dimer_xyz <- pdbfit(dimer_pdbs,
                    dimer_core.inds,
                    outpath="corefit_dimer")
```

###RMSF 

Calculate RMSF: 

```{r}
dimer_rf <- rmsf(dimer_xyz)
```

Plot RMSF: 

```{r}
plotb3(dimer_rf, sse=dimer_ref,
       ylab="RMSF")

abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")
```

### AF scores (PAE score plots) 

First, read JSON Files
```{r}
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
dimer_pae_files <- list.files(
  path="hiv_dimer_23119_0",

  full.names=TRUE
)

basename(dimer_pae_files)

```

```{r}
dimer_pae1 <- read_json(dimer_pae_files[1], simplifyVector=TRUE)
dimer_pae5 <- read_json(dimer_pae_files[5], simplifyVector=TRUE)

attributes(dimer_pae1)
```

```{r}
head(dimer_pae1$plddt)

dimer_pae1$max_pae
dimer_pae5$max_pae
```
Now Plot the models: 

PAE1
```{r}
plot.dmat(dimer_pae1$pae,

          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

PAE 5
```{r}
plot.dmat(dimer_pae5$pae,
```

### Residue Conservation

```{r}
dimer_aln_file <- list.files(
  path="hiv_dimer_23119_0",
  pattern=".a3m$",
  full.names=TRUE
)

dimer_aln_file
```

```{r}
dimer_aln <- read.fasta(dimer_aln_file[1],
                       to.upper=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dim(dimer_aln$ali)
```

```{r}
dimer_sim <- conserv(dimer_aln)
```

```{r}
plotb3(dimer_sim[1:99],
       sse=trim.pdb(dimer_ref, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

```{r}
dimer_con <- consensus(dimer_aln, cutoff=0.9)

dimer_con$seq
```

```{r}
dimer_m1.pdb <- read.pdb(dimer_pdb_files[1])

dimer_occ <- vec2resno(
  c(dimer_sim[1:99], dimer_sim[1:99]),
  dimer_m1.pdb$atom$resno
)

write.pdb(dimer_m1.pdb,
          o=dimer_occ,
          file="dimer_conserv.pdb")
```

### Residue Conservation

```{r}
gene_aln_file <- list.files(
  path="findagene_a7d40",
  pattern="\\.a3m$",
  full.names=TRUE
)

gene_aln_file
```

```{r}
gene_aln <- read.fasta(gene_aln_file[1],
                       to.upper=TRUE)
```

```{r}
dim(gene_aln$ali)
```

```{r}
gene_sim <- conserv(gene_aln)
```

```{r}
plotb3(gene_sim,
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

```{r}
#with lower cut off,amino acids shown 
gene_con <- consensus(gene_aln, cutoff=0.7)
gene_con$seq
```

```{r}
# Had to ask AI for assistance here
#Select conservation scores that correspond to actual amino acids 
# in my Find-A-Gene protein, excluding gap positions in the MSA.
# Unlike the HIV-PR dimer, my protein has only one chain,
# so the conservation scores do not need to be repeated.


gene_scores <- gene_sim[
  which(!(gene_aln$ali[1,] %in% c("-", ".")))
]

```

```{r}
gene_m1.pdb <- read.pdb(gene_pdb_files[1])
gene_occ <- vec2resno(gene_scores, gene_m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(gene_m1.pdb, o=gene_occ, file="findagene_conserv.pdb")
```
